request.description: The document checklist for this application, with conditions resolved against the borrower's facts. Each item says whether it is `satisfied` and lists the documents counted for it: the application's own uploads plus profile-level ones, excluding rejected, deleted and stale (past `freshUntil`) documents. Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.

response.name: 200 OK
